scope: Frozen C1 representation comparisons, internal model development only.

definitions.core: Largest fully occupied central-plane hex ball; independently checked by explicit missing-site membership at every event. tip largest occupied radius, gap=tip-core.
definitions.distance: Lattice-radius cell count times each row dxUm; ring counts are occupancy, not physical mass.
definitions.plateau: First exact-tip plateau with observed exit. Minimum positive duration over complete named cohort, sampled from each own entry at 0,.25,.5,.75 Dtip. Different absolute ages and radial increments.
definitions.brackets: At-or-before and next event including exact-event-time alternatives; sensitivity bounds not statistical uncertainty. No interpolation.
definitions.commonAge: Minimum terminal physical age over named cohort; quarter/half increments use that shared clock.

stages.reason: Full cohort lacks observed entry/exit of at least one first exact-tip plateau. No reduced cohort or terminal-time substitute.
Full cohort lacks observed entry/exit of at least one first exact-tip plateau. No reduced cohort or terminal-time substitute.

limits: Two spacings and bracketed seed thicknesses are not continuum convergence or domain independence.
Matched physical-tip samples occur at different absolute ages; fine/coarse plateau radial increments differ.
Common-age growth and gap magnitudes remain representation-sensitive.
Tip9/18 thick and union cohorts are unavailable because a size-target endpoint lacks a plateau exit.
This is central-plane filled-core delay behind tips, not evidence of a permanent hollow core or physical causality.
